definitions: A set of agreements reached in Geneva, Switzerland, in 1954, primarily concerning the future of Vietnam and the Indochina region.
The agreements that effectively divided Vietnam into North and South at the 17th parallel and called for nationwide elections in 1956.
examples: The Geneva Accords were signed in 1954.
The division of Vietnam was a key outcome of the Geneva Accords.
Many historians analyze the impact of the Geneva Accords on the Vietnam War.
